name: CraneLiftPlanManager
tagline: Lift plans, capacity checks, lift categories, approvals and the daily crane schedule – in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete crane-lifting module for construction: lift planners record load, rigging, crane, radius and chart capacity; the app calculates utilisation and the required lift category, takes the plan through independent approval, schedules it on a per-crane day timeline with clash detection and controls the start with the pre-lift checklist, operator and wind limit. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages, starts in demo mode and connects to any table in a few clicks.
features: Gross load, utilisation and required category (Routine / Complex / Critical) on every plan
Site maximum utilisation and overload protection
Daily crane schedule with clash detection, changeover buffer and crane-hour limits
Drag-and-drop and keyboard rescheduling; crane change sends the plan back to Revise
Independent approval, supervisor, permit and lift height rules for complex and critical lifts
Configurable pre-lift checklist, operator and wind reading before the lift starts
Wind holds and suspensions with reasons
Capacity calculator – create a plan straight from the check
Lift briefs and CSV export through OnAction
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; read-only and disabled states
controlType: standard (2 controls: CraneLiftPlanManager data-set + CraneLiftPlanManagerPortal field)
